Presumably, the objective was to make the mice more useful as laboratory animals by increasing their resistance and longevity. The unexpected result is a sterile creature with neither attribute, but a really unexpected side effect: when the animal dies, three duplicates are created, sharing all memories of its parent.

Rapid successive fission events are also harmful to the creature itself. If less than a few years pass between events, the mouse eventually perishes, unable to sustain its life cycle.

This fission mouse is of third generation, indicating the fission process has happened twice recently, making it weaker. A third fission event will probably kill the creature for good.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_FlamingoPhoenix.description: Феникс-фламинго — величественная птица с ослепительным огненным оперением, плод имперских генетических экспериментов.
LanguageData.AA_FoamBelcher.description: An organic, firefoam pod produced by giant insects. When it senses fire, the pod sprays a fire-retardant foam in a cone. Contrary to basic foam pods it won't be destroyed after some time, but needs to be built on the creep. Needs insect jelly to work.
LanguageData.AA_FoamBelcher.label: пеномёт
LanguageData.AA_FoamBelcher_Gun.description: An organic, firefoam pod produced by giant insects. When it senses fire, the pod sprays a fire-retardant foam in a cone. Contrary to basic foam pods it won't be destroyed after some time, but needs to be built on the creep. Needs insect jelly to work.
LanguageData.AA_FoamBelcher_Gun.label: пеномёт
LanguageData.AA_FreezePod.description: A bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects. Glows under its own light for a long time, then dies. Seems to emanate a chilling cold.
LanguageData.AA_FreezePod.label: капсула заморозки
LanguageData.AA_FrostAve.description: Морозный страус — крупная нелетающая птица с плотным пуховым оперением, спасающим от жесточайших буранов.
LanguageData.AA_FrostLynx.description: Морозная рысь — генно-инженерный гибрид рыси и снежного барса, обладающий великолепным мехом и острыми когтями.
LanguageData.AA_FrostPuff.label: морозный воздух
LanguageData.AA_FrostboundBehemoth.description: Ледяной бегемот — массивная полярная особь, чьё морозное дыхание способно замораживать цели за считанные секунды.
LanguageData.AA_Frostling.description: Perhaps a distant offshoot or an evolutionary relative of the sleek Nightling, the Frostling is a predator adapted to extremely low temperatures. The Frostling is a nocturnal animal that preys on the strange creatures inhabiting the frozen wastes.
LanguageData.AA_Frostmite.description: A large parasite usually found in cold places. They sweep the cold barren lands in search of corpses buried in the snow, eating the preserved flesh and leaving a ravaged skeleton in its place; devoid of their former identity.\n\nArt by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_FungalHusk.description: Грибная оболочка — раздутый бродячий труп, реанимированный спорами опасного боевого кордицепса.
LanguageData.AA_GallatrossHorn.description: Рог галлатроса. Этот несокрушимый рог невероятно ценен на чёрном рынке, учитывая колоссальную опасность охоты на этого зверя.
LanguageData.AA_Genix.description: A genetically altered hybrid of a lynx and a snow leopard, the Genix shares its genetic template with the Frost lynx, both having diverged due to environmental pressure after their creation.\n\nWhereas the Frost lynx is perfectly adapted to cold temperatures, the Genix is usually found on milder climates, as it has a complex biological refrigeration system that allows it to decrease ambient temperature wherever it goes. If domesticated, this strange ability could perhaps be used to refrigerate an enclosed space. However, the Genix has a tendency to explode if it receives too much damage, making it a quite fragile creature.
LanguageData.AA_GiantCrownedSilkie.description: Венценосная гигантская шёлковая курица с обильной продуктивностью.
LanguageData.AA_GiantCrownedSilkieSilk.description: A soft silk produced by the giant crowned silkie. Once woven it has a very similar texture to sheep wool, but softer. Considered a luxury item.
LanguageData.AA_GiantCrownedSilkieSilk.label: шёлк венценосного шелкопряда
LanguageData.AA_Gigantelope.description: Идеальные вьючные животные, переносящие больше веса, чем позволяет обычная масса тела, благодаря трубчатым пневматизированным костям.
LanguageData.AA_GooAcidifier.description: A goo acidifier increases the acidity of a goo's internal organs, making it explode as soon as it is downed. Basically transforms goos into biological suicide bombers.
LanguageData.AA_GooAcidifier.label: кислотный преобразователь слизи
LanguageData.AA_GowMilk.description: Milk from a spined gow. Very nutritive but the reddish colour is a little unsettling.
LanguageData.AA_GowMilk.label: молоко гоу
LanguageData.AA_GreatDevourer.description: Великий пожиратель — бронированный червь с ненасытным аппетитом, поглощающий биомассу в колоссальных количествах.
LanguageData.AA_GreatDevourerEggFertilized.descriptio: Оплодотворённое яйцо великого пожирателя. Скоро из него вылупится прожорливый бронированный червь.
LanguageData.AA_GreaterBlackHiveBolt.label: большой едкий плевок
LanguageData.AA_GreenGoo.description: These amorphous, ambulatory masses of gelatinous fluid seem to be a mockery of life. Although they look like individuals, in reality they are part of a greater gelatinous superorganism, with only one objective: grow and expand.\n\nThey have been nicknamed green goo due to their ability to reproduce constantly, requiring very little sustenance, and quickly filling all available ecological niches. In the field of eschatology, a grey goo is an end-of-the-world scenario involving molecular nanotechnology in which out-of-control self-replicating robots consume all biomass while building more of themselves. A green goo scenario, however, involves biological self-replicating entities. NOTE: due to gameplay constraints, green goo will only self-replicate until the map holds 40 creatures, because I don't want to fry your computers. Note that asexual creatures can't be sterilized.
LanguageData.AA_GreyCoatedMouflon.description:
The Grey-Coated Mouflon (Ovis Cinerea) is a genetically modified variant of wild sheep that produces a thick grey wool that acts as a great insulator. This isn't however their most interesting ability: Grey-Coated Mouflons were created with a specialized organ capable of amplifying human brainwaves, acting as a biological psychic harmonizer.

If the Mouflon is happy, meaning not feeling hunger or pain, it will provide a mood bonus to nearby human beings. However, if the Mouflon is somehow suffering it will psychically affect everyone around it.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_GreyCoatedMouflonWool.description: Grey-coated mouflon wool. It provides good insulation.
LanguageData.AA_Groundrunner.description: Земляной бегун — причудливый гибрид медведя и крота, выведенный для прокладки туннелей в подземных мирах.
LanguageData.AA_Heat_Ambrosia.description:
A rare wild bush which yields the ambrosia fruit. Ambrosia fruit is delicious and produces a drug-like mood boost. Ambrosia cannot be farmed, which makes wild ambrosia groves very valuable.

Its rarity, beauty, and desirability are why ambrosia was named after the food of the ancient Greek gods.

This particular plant has been genetically modified to withstand low terrain fertility.
LanguageData.AA_Heat_Ambrosia.label: жаростойкая амброзия
LanguageData.AA_Helixien.description:
The Helixien Slug is a genetically modified strain of the Leopard Slug, intended as a fast corpse disposal aid. Aside from the obvious size alteration, the Helixien constantly secretes a foul-smelling, corrosive gas that produces an uncomfortable, itchy sensation in living beings. This gas is mostly harmless, unless it comes into contact with decaying organic matter: it greatly accelerates corpse rotting, liberating a black putrid liquid known as "purge fluid" or corpse bile. The helixien happily feeds on this liquid sludge, although it can also feed on other organic matter if needed.

The sight of a Helixien Slug is quite revolting, and watching one wallowing in a pile of human corpses is, to say the least, a deeply traumatizing experience.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_HexaGelBattery.description: Can store more electricity than blue gel batteries. As a downside, they are highly flammable, and they will violently explode if destroyed. Charged hexagel batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.
LanguageData.AA_HexaGelBattery.label: батарея на гексагеле
LanguageData.AA_Hexagel.description: A crystallized and condensed variety of blue gel. Hexagel is capable of storing much more energy than its non-refined cousin, but it also seems to be quite unstable. Hexagel can be used to build powerful batteries and generators, with the appropiate research (Batteries and Advanced Fabrication).
LanguageData.AA_Hexagel.label: гексагель
LanguageData.AA_HexagelCore.description: A hexagonal shaped energy core composed of -in itself highly unstable- hydrogen-rich blue gel stabilized within a uranium shell.
LanguageData.AA_HexagelCore.label: ядро из гексагеля
LanguageData.AA_HexagelCoreReactor.description: Produces electricity from energy stored inside hexagel cores.
LanguageData.AA_HexagelCoreReactor.label: реактор на ядрах гексагеля
LanguageData.AA_HiveEntrance.description: Вход в подземный лабиринт Чёрного Улья. Позволяет насекомым беспрепятственно выходить на поверхность.
LanguageData.AA_HiveEntrance.label: вход в Чёрный Улей
LanguageData.AA_HugeAnimaPearl.description: This huge anima pearl seems to be bursting with barely contained living energy. It can be planted and an anima tree will grow from it.
LanguageData.AA_HugeAnimaPearl.label: огромная анима-жемчужина
LanguageData.AA_HyperAcidicStomachImplant.description: Сверхацидный желудок. Занимает место желудка и позволяет изрыгать концентрированную кислоту.
LanguageData.AA_HyperAcidicStomachImplant.label: сверхацидный желудок
LanguageData.AA_InfectedAerofleet.description:
A small, floating gelatinous creature. Propelled by the hydrogen it collects from water and various plant matter, these squishy creatures wander the lands, aimlessly bouncing off objects in their path.

This Aerofleet seems to have been affected by prolonged exposure to the gases emanating from an ocular forest, and red pustules and blisters are appearing in its exterior membrane. Its hydrogen seems to be in the process of being turned into an acidic gas of unknown origins.

Aerofleets are genderless, and reproduce by strobilation, a form of asexual reproduction. Note that asexual creatures can't be sterilized. As a floating creature, Aerofleets ignore terrain movement costs.

Aerofleets slowly produce a thick, gelatinous substance known as Blue Gel. This syrupy residue can be collected and refined into an energy-dense compound, and potentially used to build powerful batteries and generators with the appropriate research (Biofuel refining, Batteries and Advanced Fabrication).
LanguageData.AA_IronhuskBeetle.description:
Ironhusk beetles were genetically engineered by one of the myriad mining companies operating on the Rim. It's a peaceful farm animal that occasionally sheds metallic husks that can be used as steel, thus negating the need for heavy machinery in mining operations. As a downside, the beetle consumes a huge amount of wood from live trees.

Sadly, the mining company that created the Ironhusk beetles didn't account for this, and several planets on the Rim are now a barren ecological disaster.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_IronhuskEggFertilized.description: Оплодотворённое яйцо жука-железнопанцирника с твёрдой металлической скорлупой.
LanguageData.AA_IronhuskEggFertilized.label: яйцо жука-железнопанцирника (оплодотв.)
LanguageData.AA_IronhuskEggUnfertilized.label: яйцо жука-железнопанцирника (неоплодотв.)
LanguageData.AA_Junglelisk.description: Джунглиск — тропическая мутация фералиска, скрывающаяся в густых кронах влажных экваториальных лесов.
LanguageData.AA_JungleliskEggFertilized.description: Оплодотворённое яйцо джунглиска. Несъедобно. Из него вылупится паук-джунглиск.
LanguageData.AA_LarvalAtispec.description:
Atispecs are strange semi-insectoid creatures that undergo a radical metamorphosis, similar to old terran butterflies. In their larval phase, atispecs are basically harmless: a medium-sized grub that feeds on plants and usually ends up as some predator's meal. Tens of thousands of atispec larvae hatch every season, and less than a dozen make it to their adult form.

An adult Atispec, however, is an entirely different matter: huge, carnivorous and venomous. Adult Atispecs are flying predators with a voracious appetite, and quite intelligent. There have been attempts to domesticate the adult specimens, but it has been found that it is not quite cost-effective to grow them during their 2-year-long vulnerable phase as larvae.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_Leather_Aerofleet.description: A fuzzy, soft layer of pliable material. Not as tough as other types of leather, but a decent insulator.
LanguageData.AA_Leather_Behemoth.description: Hard overlapping scales of draconic chitin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
LanguageData.AA_LightFocusingLensImplant.description: Фокусирующая линза. Концентрирует солнечную энергию в смертоносный лазерный луч.
LanguageData.AA_LightFocusingLensImplant.label: фокусирующая линза
LanguageData.AA_Lockjaw.description: Капканник — крупный хищник с мощнейшими челюстями, намертво сжимающимися на теле добычи.
LanguageData.AA_LuciferBug.description:
A small insectoid, genetically modified to produce small batches of Luciferium extract every few days.

Even though they are useful as a source of the dangerous drug, the fact that Luciferium is a mechanite-based drug makes luciferbugs extremely unstable, and prone to violent detonation if damaged. This detonation releases all the Luciferium accumulating on their abdomens, subjecting any nearby creatures to a dangerous drug overdose. For this reason, luciferbugs should always be kept VERY FAR AWAY from any valuable members of the colony.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/feroxiious/).
LanguageData.AA_MammothWorm.description: Мамонтовый червь — гигантский генно-модифицированный червь с мирным нравом и непробиваемой толстой шкурой.
LanguageData.AA_MammothWormEggFertilized.description: Оплодотворённое яйцо мамонтового червя. Из него вылупится гигантский мамонтовый червь.
LanguageData.AA_Mantrap.description: Мандрап — плотоядное ходячее растение, подстерегающее добычу и захлопывающееся вокруг неё живым капканом.
LanguageData.AA_MatureFleshbeast.description: The unwanted result of a genetic experiment gone wrong, fleshbeasts are usually miserable, weak creatures that ooze pus and struggle to keep breathing for longer than a few days. Sometimes, however, a fleshbeast manages to survive, and even thrive. Perhaps it was foolishly released into the wild, where it managed to stabilize and grow. Or perhaps it was stronger than average, and managed to subdue and devour its imprudent creators. In any case, it has now turned into a pulsating, fleshy behemoth with a ravenous appetite.\n\nMature fleshbeasts swallow their prey whole, storing up to 5 creatures on its huge stomach for later consumption. Prey may survive for up to one day, but they'll later be consumed and expelled as skeletized remains.
LanguageData.AA_MeadowAve.description: Луговой страус — крупная нелетающая птица с ярким оперением, питающаяся ягодами и травами.
LanguageData.AA_MegaLouse.description: Мегавошь — огромный бронированный жук-мокрица, использовавшийся в древних войнах как штурмовой танк передовой.
LanguageData.AA_MegalouseEggFertilized.description: Оплодотворённое яйцо мегавши. Из него вылупится бронированная мегавошь.
LanguageData.AA_Metallovore.description: Metallovores are repulsive creatures genetically modified to fill a very specific niche: eating metals. The writhing tentacles in the animal's mouth secrete an organic substance that is capable of quickly rusting and dissolving most common metals, turning them into small flakes that serve as sustenance for the metallovore. They prefer small chunks of metal, since they can be more easily digested, but they will resort to digging into rocks in search of new metal if they can find none available.\n\nPresumably, they were created to get rid of scrap metal, but they are mostly found in the wild now.
LanguageData.AA_Mime.description: Мим — ужасающий инопланетный хищник, способный безупречно копировать облик человека, пока не наступит приступ неутолимого голода.
LanguageData.AA_MothSilk.description: A very tough silk extracted from Angel moths. Very poor insulator.
LanguageData.AA_MothSilk.label: шёлк мотылька
LanguageData.AA_Murkling.description: A distant relative of the nightling, murklings are -in fact- quite their opposite. They are not as fierce nor are they proficient hunters, often scavenging in packs for scraps left behind by the more apt predators. Their most distinctive features are the abnormally elongated structures on their snouts, which are theorized to produce specific vibrational sequences that allow for discrete communication between pack members. Their physical weakness is compensated for with above average intellect, allowing them to outsmart organisms as intelligent as the Forsaken. Their reputation for stealthily stealing supplies across the Rim has earned them the nickname 'thief of the night'.\n\nSpecial abilities: A Murkling's bite can inflict the bubonic plague. The delicate tendrils on their snouts can dissolve nearby corpses and turn them into semi-liquid carrion that can feed the Murkling.
LanguageData.AA_MutantArm.description: This arm twitches and bends in strange unnatural ways, as if it had a mind of its own. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.
LanguageData.AA_MutantArm.label: мутантная рука
LanguageData.AA_MutantEye.description: This eye constantly blinks on its own, like a nervous tic, and a second set of vertical eyelids seems to be present behind the normal, human ones. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.
LanguageData.AA_MutantEye.label: мутантный глаз
LanguageData.AA_MutantLeg.description: Мутантная конечность. Значительно повышает скорость перемещения животного.
LanguageData.AA_MutantLeg.label: мутантная лапа
LanguageData.AA_MycoidColossus.description: Грибной колосс — исполинское создание микотических болот, чьё тело служит средой обитания для редких видов грибов.
LanguageData.AA_MycoidColossusSpores.description: Оплодотворённые споры грибного колосса. Из них произрастает гигантский колосс.
LanguageData.AA_MycoidColossusSpores.label: споры грибного колосса (оплодотв.)
LanguageData.AA_Needlepost.description: Иглоствол — разумный кактус с примитивной нервной системой, способный защищаться залпом ядовитых игл.
LanguageData.AA_Needleroll.description: Needlerolls are needleposts that have evolved to grow in the most arid and dry environments in the Rim.\n\nNeedleposts need almost no sustenance, absorbing all the energy they need from sunlight and minute amounts of water that they extract from morning dew. Like needleposts, they need a huge amount of sunlight (or equivalent). Nights won't affect them, but a solar eclipse could be fatal to them.
LanguageData.AA_NightAve.description: A large flightless bird, black as night. It seems to share part of its phenotype with the Nightling, hinting that they both originate from the same planet: a RimWorld orbiting a very faint star -the native planet of an elusive race known as the Forsaken-. Night Aves have adapted to environments with very low sunlight, and they are purely nocturnal animals.\n\nNight Aves are amazing mounts, much faster than horses, and if properly trained they can be ridden into battle at incredible speeds (this interaction needs the Giddy-Up, combat mounts mod, and it will make the Night Aves move 50% faster when used as mounts).
LanguageData.AA_NightMilk.description: Very nutritive but the colour is more than a little unsettling.
LanguageData.AA_NightMilk.label: ночное молоко
LanguageData.AA_NightMule.description: Ночной мул — выносливое вьючное животное сумеречных биомов, способное нести огромные тюки груза.
LanguageData.AA_NightRam.description: The Nightram is a stubborn herbivore that shares much of its genome with the predatory Nightling, hinting at a common origin. They both originate from a RimWorld orbiting a very faint star -the native planet of an elusive race known as the Forsaken- so they have adapted to environments with low sunlight. When found on other worlds, the Nightram are exclusively nocturnal, instinctively avoiding natural sunlight.\n\nNightrams are peaceful unless disturbed or threatened.
LanguageData.AA_NightWool.description: This dark hued wool is soft, light and provides very good insulation. Stronger than other similar wools.
LanguageData.AA_NightWool.label: ночная шерсть
LanguageData.AA_Nightling.description: Ночник — грациозный ночной хищник с рядами острых игл на спине, выслеживающий жертв под покровом тьмы.
LanguageData.AA_OcularCactus.description: Окулярный кактус — кактус, поражённый странной аномальной энергией и покрытый живыми моргающими глазами.
LanguageData.AA_OcularGas.label: окулярный газ
LanguageData.AA_OcularJelly.description: The Rim is filled with creatures that might be the product of either accelerated evolution from terrestrial origins, or, more often, of ancient human genetic engineering gone awry. The ocular jelly, however, is so fundamentally weird that some scientists have speculated about a possible extradimensional origin. Or perhaps it is just some cruel, if elaborate, practical joke.\n\nIt seems to have some biological similarities with the Aerofleet, being filled with a buoyant gas, but its effects on terrestrial ecosystems are incredibly unusual: the creature releases clouds of a reddish gas that is harmless to animals. However, when flora is exposed to it, it mutates and turns into strange specimens that share 98% of its genome with the jelly. This flora is almost inedible, and its relationship with the ocular jelly remains as of yet unexplained. As a floating creature, Ocular Jellies ignore terrain movement costs. Note that asexual creatures can't be sterilized.
LanguageData.AA_OcularJellyMeat.description: Raw meat from an ocular jelly.\n\nChewy, gelatinous and insipid. Similar in texture to a jellyfish.
LanguageData.AA_OcularNightling.description: A mutated nightling, created by infusing an animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption. Sturdier, more docile than normal Nightlings.
LanguageData.AA_OcularOriginator.description: Окулярный прародитель — полупрозрачное аморфное создание, распространяющее влияние окулярного биома.
LanguageData.AA_OvergrownColossus.description: Заросший колосс — циклопическое травоядное создание, на спине которого сформировалась целая самостоятельная экосистема.
LanguageData.AA_Overgrown_DropPod.description: This standard issue drop pod seems to have been modified to host a small self-contained ecosystem. As soon as it impacted, strange creeping vines and weird creatures emerged from it. It seems to be some kind of terraforming machine.\n\nYou can destroy it to avoid release of hostile lifeforms into this region, or wait until its work is done to see what happens.
LanguageData.AA_Overgrown_DropPod.label: заросшая десантная капсула
LanguageData.AA_PebbleMit.description: Pebblemits are bouldermits that have evolved in Rimworlds rich in narrow, labyrinthine caves, where massive size is more a hindrance than an advantage.\n\nInstead of huge boulders, pebblemits use much smaller rocks as protection, slowly dragging them along the ground. Small blocks of stone periodically get loose from this rock, and they can be used as building materials.
LanguageData.AA_PedigreedRaptor.description: A genetically reconstructed dromaeosaurid, the pedigreed raptor is a perfect example of the decadence present in a lot of Glitterworlds. Commissioned by bored Glitterworld elites as a symbol of status and wealth, these beasts are made to compete in judged events where the owners win titles depending on how well their animals conform to their breed's standards.\n\nSet loose in the Rim, the raptors are usually short-lived, since they depend on their human owners for survival, their violent instincts having been bred out of them long ago. They are however excellent companions, and they are quite pretty (mechanics-wise, a pedigreed raptor will increase by 15% the beauty of any room it is present at).
LanguageData.AA_PhoenixOwlcat.description:
A genetically modified feline with avian characteristics, the Phoenix Owlcat was created as a durable alternative to fragile baseline cats. A loyal companion that isn't so easily hunted and slaughtered by the hostile lifeforms present on the planets of the Rim.

The ancient popular folklore of cats having nine lives was used as a pattern to create the Phoenix Owlcat: a swarm of powerful mechanites in its bloodstream is capable of saving it from up to 9 lethal wounds before being lost to decoherence.

RW animal graphic inspired by original creation by RobtheDoodler (check his Deviant Art page at https://www.deviantart.com/robthedoodler!).
LanguageData.AA_Plant_PollenTrumpet.description: A cultivated flower with a tubular structure and bright orange flowers when mature. Pollen trumpets are the favourite food source of empress butterflies.
LanguageData.AA_Plant_PollenTrumpet.label: пыльцевая трубка
LanguageData.AA_Plasmorph.description: Плазморф — причудливая мутантная улитка, способная аккумулировать и выбрасывать нестабильные плазменные заряды.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBeak.description: Simple prosthetic beak. Should be able to replace almost any avian-like beak.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBeak.label: простой протез клюва
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBuoyancyMechanism.descripti: Simple prosthetic buoyancy mechanism. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBuoyancyMechanism.label: простой протез плавучести
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticShell.description: Simple prosthetic shell. Should be able to replace carapaces and shells.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticShell.label: простой протез панциря
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticTentacle.description: Simple prosthetic tentacle. Should be able to replace almost any tentacle.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticTentacle.label: простой протез щупальца
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticWing.description: Simple prosthetic wing. Should be able to replace any type of wing.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticWing.label: простой протез крыла
LanguageData.AA_QuadTeslaCannonImplant.description: Четырёхствольная тесла-пушка. Плазменная турель, вживлённая в тело зверя.
LanguageData.AA_QuadTeslaCannonImplant.label: четырёхствольная тесла-пушка
LanguageData.AA_Radyak.description: The radyak is a peaceful herbivore bred to thrive in high radiation environments. Its ruminant digestive tract is composed of six bionic stomachs, reinforced with a lead-lined biolattice designed to extract residual radioactive material from grass cells. This radioactive material is then deposited in crystal-like formations that pierce the hard skin of the creature. This crystals can be harvested periodically, and refined into uranium in a standard chemfuel refinery.\n\nThe technology behind creating such carefully engineered creatures is completely out of reach of most Rim societies, so a radyak is a valued acquisition indeed.
LanguageData.AA_RandomBricks.description: This should never appear ingame. If it does, it's a bug
LanguageData.AA_RandomBricks.label: случайные кирпичи
LanguageData.AA_RandomStones.description: This should never appear ingame. If it does, it's a bug
LanguageData.AA_RandomStones.label: случайный камень
LanguageData.AA_RangedSpinneretImplant.description: Дистанционная паутина. Позволяет опутать и обездвижить приближающихся врагов.
LanguageData.AA_RangedSpinneretImplant.label: дистанционная паутина
LanguageData.AA_RaptorShrimp.description: Раптор-креветка — крупное земноводное создание с потрясающей скоростью регенерации и острыми серповидными лапами.
LanguageData.AA_Ravager.description: Опустошитель — бронированный боевой инсектоид Чёрного Улья, созданный для штурма укреплённых бункеров механоидов.
LanguageData.AA_RayHound.description: Ray-hounds (Salvator Electricus), also called Reptile Hounds, are a genetically engineered species based on the Argentine black and white tegu, with several traits from the common electric eel. The pair of fleshy tentacles extending from a ray-hound's skull are electrogenic, and are used by the animal as a defense mechanism against predators. In practice, Ray-hounds were created as an easily trainable biological defense against mechanoids, since an electrical discharge from a ray-hound's tentacles can easily disable electronic circuits. Ray-hounds make amenable pets, as they tend to become acclimated to their owners and are generally quite docile as adults. Art by MahrimbArt (check his Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/mahrimb.art/)
LanguageData.AA_Razorjack.description: Бритвозуб — агрессивный хищник с двойным рядом челюстей, разрывающий плоть на мелкие куски.
LanguageData.AA_RedGas.label: красный газ
LanguageData.AA_RedGoo.description: This blob of bubbling organic matter seems to be an extension of the terrain itself, a disfigured excrescence given a semblance of life.\n\nThe red goo seem to thrive in the strangely bizarre environment of the ocular forest, nibbling on the aberrant vegetation and periodically cloning themselves. NOTE: due to gameplay constraints, red goo will only self-replicate until the map holds 15 creatures, because I don't want to fry your computers. Note that asexual creatures can't be sterilized.
LanguageData.AA_RedLeaves.description: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based, and it seems to be decaying quickly from exposure to a terrestrial environment.
LanguageData.AA_RedLeaves.label: инопланетное растение
LanguageData.AA_RedPlantsTall.description: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based, and it seems to be decaying quickly from exposure to a terrestrial environment.
LanguageData.AA_RedPlantsTall.label: инопланетное растение
LanguageData.AA_RedSpore.description: Красная спора — аномальное создание неизвестного происхождения, построенное на основе галлия вместо углерода. Чрезвычайно нестабильно, парит над землёй и яростно взрывается при гибели.
LanguageData.AA_RipperHound.description: Гончая-потрошитель — биоинженерный пёс, специально выведенный для истребления инсектоидов.
LanguageData.AA_RottingMound.description: Куча гниющей органики, источающая резкий запах брожения и гнили.
LanguageData.AA_RottingMound.label: курган перебродившей гнили
LanguageData.AA_RottingMoundItem.description: Кусок перебродившей органической массы, пригодный для использования в некоторых биохимических процессах.
LanguageData.AA_RottingMoundItem.label: курган перебродившей гнили
LanguageData.AA_RoughPlatedMonitor.description: Панцирный варан — крупная чешуйчатая рептилия с костяными наростами на спине, обитающая в суровых пустошах.
LanguageData.AA_RoyalAve.description: Royal Aves are large flightless birds with colorful feathers. Royal Aves were originally wild Meadow Aves that have been crossbred for generations to reduce their stubbornness and increase their fluffiness. Some of these prized pets get freed into the wild, a life that they are poorly adapted for. Plumage in Royal Aves is more flamboyant than usual: if lucky you might get your hands on the incredibly rare Rainbow Ave, which does nothing special besides from looking bizarre.\n\nRoyal Aves are amazing mounts, much faster than horses, and if properly trained they can be ridden into battle at incredible speeds (this interaction needs the Giddy-Up, combat mounts mod, and it will make the Royal Aves move 50% faster when used as mounts).
LanguageData.AA_SandLion.description: Песчаный лев — пустынная мутация полярного льва, приспособленная к маскировке в дюнах и внезапным прыжкам из засады.
LanguageData.AA_SandLion_Leather.description: Cream coloured thick leather covered in a long, rugged mat of fur. Harvested from a sand lion. This thick skin insulates from heat and protects really well.
LanguageData.AA_SandProwler.description: Песчаный бродяга — причудливый гибрид льва, акулы и сцинка, стремительно рассекающий пески пустынь.
LanguageData.AA_SandPuff.label: мелкодисперсный песок
LanguageData.AA_SandSquid.description: Песчаный кальмар — сухопутное мутантное головоногое, скользящее по пескам и стреляющее липкими чернилами.
LanguageData.AA_ShadowCharger.description: Генетическая линия теневых таранов, адаптированных к постоянной мгле.
LanguageData.AA_ShockGoat.description: Шок-коза — одомашненное парнокопытное, способное накапливать статический заряд на шерсти и рогах.
LanguageData.AA_Skiphound.description: Пси-гончая — результат скрещивания ДНК псовых с анимус-воксом. Способна мгновенно телепортироваться в бою.
LanguageData.AA_SkySteel.description: A weird iron based compound found in a fallen asteroid. Stronger than normal steel, but a terrible insulator.
LanguageData.AA_SkySteel.label: небесная сталь
LanguageData.AA_SkySteelClumps.description: This strange mineral is very hard and resilient. Perhaps you could find a way to extract useable materials from it.
LanguageData.AA_SkySteelClumps.label: странный блестящий минерал
LanguageData.AA_Skyeel.description: Небесный угорь — грациозное парящее существо, дрейфующее в атмосфере на водородных воздушных полостях.
LanguageData.AA_Slurrypede.description: Although rare, mechanoids have been known to capture prisoners, and the Slurrypede is their solution to feed them in the most efficient way possible. The Slurrypede is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of devouring almost anything and processing it into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and completely indigestible for herbivores.\n\nSlurrypedes are docile, almost never hostile, and in case a mechanoid base is destroyed and one of them manages to survive, they tend to roam the wilderness aimlessly, consuming any organic material in their path and turning it into nutrient paste.
LanguageData.AA_SmokeInk.label: распылённые токсичные чернила
LanguageData.AA_SpinedGow.description:
Spined Gows are farm animals with cow and goat characteristics, bred to survive in extreme environments.

Spined Gows are herbivorous, happy to graze in any grassy meadow. However, their neural spine sails provide a different and additional type of sustenance: when the creature is near a geologically active terrain, such as liquid lava, the sail absorbs part of the intense radiating heat and converts it into chemical energy.

Spìned Gows provide a very nutritious milk.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> The part about the sail absorbing heat is just fluff text, there is no real gameplay effect. Many people have tried to look for the code controlling that, when it's just some bullshit lore I cooked up in a couple of minutes XD
LanguageData.AA_SummitCrab.description: Вершинный краб — легендарный гигантский валунник, выросший до циклопических размеров и несущий на спине целую гору.
LanguageData.AA_Summoned_Eyeling.description: A grotesquely enlarged eye, crawling around with the help of a few fleshy tentacles. Not very useful at all. Created by infusing an animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.
LanguageData.AA_Swarmling.description: Роевик — мелкий проворный паразит, способный стремительно размножаться при обилии пищи.
LanguageData.AA_TarGuzzler.description: This menacing-looking beast might seem to be a truly alien creature, but in reality it was artificially created as living waste disposal. The tar guzzler creeps along the parched mud with six strong tentacles, avidly searching for its favourite food: puddles of viscous tar.\n\nTar guzzlers have a very limited intelligence, and -being disgusting creatures- they don't have any natural predators, so they are usually content to just be left alone.
LanguageData.AA_TeratogenicOriginator.description: This amorphous, flesh coloured, translucent creature seems to lack everything but the most basic instincts, moving around slowly and sometimes devouring any plant it comes in contact with, incorporating it into its cytoplasm. There are some chunks of seemingly normal flesh floating inside it.\n\nTeratogenic Originators are basically an enormous clonal colony of pluripotent stem cells, capable of differentiating into different tissues. They were engineered by a group of unethical scientists as a cheap way to create lab-grown limbs suitable for transplants, but the end results is less than ideal. These strange mutant limbs can be periodically excised from the creature and used at will. Note that asexual creatures can't be sterilized.
LanguageData.AA_Terramorph.description: This strange looking crustacean was created with a single goal in mind: mineral processing. The Terramorph can feed on iron compounds, and process them chemically to slowly turn them into a hardened mineral usually know as "sky steel", that is normally only found in asteroids.\n\nThe transmutation process is very slow, so the Terramorph needs to spend quite a lot of time surrounded by mined Steel lumps. The Terramorph can also slowly consume, but not convert, steel slag chunks.
LanguageData.AA_TetraSlug.description:
These massive slugs are a common sight among Glitterworld controlled territories, where they lumber about as glorified power plants. Outside of one, they are deployed as a mobile power source for Glitterworld research expeditions. It is rare to see one without the iconic power cores that protrude from their backs, as their unique bodily chemical composition is capable of outputting power that far surpasses any known natural sources. Thus, they are widely valued by every technologically developing civilization throughout the galaxy.

While a gentle giant that would prefer to run away instead of fight, modified slugs come armored with plasteel shells, quad cores that can act as Tesla cannons, and a Tactical AI inserted within the brain that takes over and makes no hesitation to use all of its armament to obliterate any perceived threat within vicinity.

Properly outfitted Tetra slugs will slowly recharge batteries on their vicinity (most modded batteries are supported).
LanguageData.AA_TheHeuristicEye.description: This eye analyzes its surroundings with carefully planned discipline, missing no details.
LanguageData.AA_TheHeuristicEye.label: эвристический глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheMeretriciousEye.description: This gaudy looking eye seems to have a life of its own, trying to catch the attention of other people with carefully directed winks and furtive, sultry glances that beckon with a false allure. It allows its host to recover quicker from psychic exhaustion.
LanguageData.AA_TheMeretriciousEye.label: соблазнительный глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheNumbingEye.description: This strange mutant eye is covered by dense plates of bone instead of a normal fleshy eyelid, and seems to be almost impervious to pain.
LanguageData.AA_TheNumbingEye.label: ошеломляющий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheOmniscientEye.description: Всевидящее око. Ужасный мутантный орган с треугольным зрачком, наделяющий владельца псионическим зрением.
LanguageData.AA_TheOmniscientEye.label: всевидящий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheQuiescentEye.description: An eye that never blinks, keeping itself moist by unknown means. It pervades its host with a sense of preternatural calmness.
LanguageData.AA_TheQuiescentEye.label: умиротворяющий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheRecalcitrantEye.description: Упорствующий глаз. Мутантный полуприкрытый глаз, защищающий носителя от психических воздействий.
LanguageData.AA_TheRecalcitrantEye.label: строптивый глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheSpasmodicEye.description: An eye that can't stop blinking uncontrollably. While extremely distracting and disconcerting, it allows its host to cast more psychic powers before exhaustion.
LanguageData.AA_TheSpasmodicEye.label: судорожный глаз
LanguageData.AA_Thermadon.description: Термодон — тяжелобронированный огнедышащий жук Чёрного Улья, изрыгающий потоки раскалённой химической смеси.
LanguageData.AA_Thunderbeast.description: The thunderbeast is a swine-like mammal capable of generating large electric currents by way of a highly specialized nervous system that has the capacity to synchronize the activity of disc-shaped, electricity-producing cells packed into a specialized electric organ.\n\nThough they were initially created to serve as a way to generate bio-electricity similarly to Tetra slugs, thunderbeasts have naturally evolved over the centuries making them extremely unstable. Thunderbeasts can release jolts of electricity at great distances, and they will negatively affect weather if they are slaughtered. Thankfully, predators usually give them a wide berth.
LanguageData.AA_Thunderox.description: Громовой бык, вырабатывающий мощные биоэлектрические поля.
LanguageData.AA_UnblinkingEye.description: A floating chitinous creature covered in spikes and unblinking eyes. Created by infusing a very large animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.
LanguageData.AA_UraniumCrystals.description: This crystal can be refined in a chemfuel refinery into uranium.
LanguageData.AA_UraniumCrystals.label: неочищенные кристаллы урана
LanguageData.AA_VenomousSpitterImplant.description: Ядовитый плеватель. Позволяет поражать цели ядовитыми зарядами на расстоянии.
LanguageData.AA_VenomousSpitterImplant.label: ядовитый плеватель
LanguageData.AA_Wildpawn.description: Дикопешка — подвижная растительная форма жизни, бродящая по лесам в поисках солнечного света и воды.
LanguageData.AA_WildpawnSpores.description: Оплодотворённые споры дикопешки. Из них вырастет дикопешка.
LanguageData.AA_WildpawnSpores.label: споры дикопешки (оплодотв.)
LanguageData.AA_Wildpod.description: Дикопод — массивное разумное существо из полуразложившейся растительной массы и мицелия.
LanguageData.AA_WildpodSpores.description: Оплодотворённые споры дикопода. Из них вырастет массивный дикопод.
LanguageData.AA_WildpodSpores.label: споры дикопода (оплодотв.)
LanguageData.AA_WindBeast.description: The windbeast is a mechanoid-infused variant of the thunderbeast, in which the bioelectric organs have been removed and replaced with fleshy tentacles housing a distributed net of weather-affecting mechanites.\n\nThese deployable mechanite swarms have the ability to affect the weather in a localized manner, creating pressure gradients that may evolve into full-blown hurricane winds. This effect is used offensively by the creature, and is specially dangerous if it is killed, as the large sudden release of all mechanites can cause a tornado. Thankfully, predators usually give them a wide berth and they are quite rare.
LanguageData.AB_BionicClaw.description: Улучшенный бионический коготь из прочных сплавов для опасных хищников.
LanguageData.AB_BionicClaw.label: бионический коготь
LanguageData.AB_RawRedSlime.description: Raw red slime. This thing is edible. Barely.
LanguageData.AB_RawRedSlime.label: сырая красная слизь
LanguageData.AB_SimpleProstheticClaw.description: Простой протез когтя для восстановления боеспособности животного.
LanguageData.AB_SimpleProstheticClaw.label: простой протез когтя
LanguageData.GU_RedWood.description: This red tinged wood is oddly strong, and a sweet scent emanates from it. Less flammable than terrestrial wood, but quite ugly.
LanguageData.GU_RedWood.label: красное дерево
LanguageData.Leather_BlackChitin.description: Hard overlapping scales of insectoid chitin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
LanguageData.Leather_BlackChitin.label: чёрный хитин инсектоида
LanguageData.Leather_Cactus.description: This strange material seems to be part animal hide, part living plant tissue. It traps cold water inside, acting as an incredibly good thermal insulator for hot climates.
LanguageData.Leather_Cactus.label: кожа разумного растения
LanguageData.Leather_Chitin.description: Hard overlapping scales of insect chitin. It is exceptionally durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
LanguageData.Leather_Chitin.label: твёрдый хитин
LanguageData.Leather_Gallatross.description: This furry hide is of exceptional quality. Probably one of the best possible leathers on the Rim.
LanguageData.Leather_IronChitin.description: Super hard overlapping scales of insect chitin. It seems to be reinforced with some kind of iron lattice.
LanguageData.Leather_IronChitin.label: железный хитин
LanguageData.Leather_Night.description: Thick leather, darker than the darkest night. This thick skin insulates and protects very well.
LanguageData.Leather_Night.label: ночная кожа
LanguageData.Leather_RaptorPlates.description: Overlapping plates of hardened chitin. Really durable in combat, but provides little protection from weather.
LanguageData.Leather_RaptorPlates.label: закалённый хитин
LanguageData.VEF_AdvancedAnimalImplantsTable.descript: Верстак для извлечения особых способностей животных и их трансплантации другим особям. Позволяет пересаживать дальнобойные атаки между видами.
LanguageData.VEF_AdvancedAnimalImplantsTable.label: верстак продвинутого протезирования животных
LanguageData.VFEI2_AA_ArtificialBlackHive.description: Искусственно созданное гнездо гигантских насекомых, способное выводить различные особи генолинии Чёрного Улья.
LanguageData.VFEI2_AA_ArtificialBlackHive.label: искусственный Чёрный Улей
LanguageData.VFEI2_AA_BlackHive.description: Природное гнездо инсектоидов Чёрного Улья. При тревоге выпускает агрессивных насекомых-защитников.
LanguageData.VFEI2_AA_BlackHive.label: чёрный улей
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackEmpress.description: Чёрная Императрица — редчайший колоссальный инсектоид Чёрного Улья, высшая вершина эволюции штурмовых роев.
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackInsectoidCocoon.description: These jelly cocoons keep black swarmlings safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats while they undergo a metamorphosis process. After some time has passed, the cocoon will burst, releasing a fully grown insectoid.
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackInsectoidCocoon.label: чёрный кокон инсектоида
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackQueen.description: Чёрная Королева — гигантская матка Чёрного Улья, руководящая развитием роя и яйцекладкой.
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackSwarmling.description: Чёрный роевик — личиночная боевая форма Чёрного Улья, быстрая и нападающая огромными стаями.
LanguageData.VFEI2_PherocoreBlack.description: Феромонное микроядро Чёрного Улья. Необходимый компонент для постройки специализированных инсектоидных гнезд.
LanguageData.VFEI2_PherocoreBlack.label: чёрное фероядро
LanguageData.VFEI2_Thumper_BlackEmpress.description: Вибрационный грохот. При активации испускает мощные сейсмические импульсы, привлекающие на поле боя свирепую Чёрную Императрицу.
LanguageData.VFEI2_Thumper_BlackEmpress.label: колотильщик чёрной императрицы
